transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Marcus. I am in absolute tears here. We had our full fibre broadband installed yesterday, and your engineer told us our landline number of twenty-five years had been permanently ceased! That number is the only contact my eighty-eight-year-old mother has for us!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me pull up the migration order. First I need to complete security verification. What is your full name and the installation address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Elisha Vance, 29 Meadow Close, Nottingham, NG7 3HQ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the security question answer for your place of birth, Elisha?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Lincoln.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what I understand is during the full fibre switchover from copper yesterday, your existing landline telephone number of twenty-five years was ceased rather than ported across to Digital Voice, and we need to recover that number onto your hub adapter urgently. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly it! My mother has dementia and cannot remember new numbers, so losing this number is an absolute disaster for our family!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of this case and check the telephone number allocation database on the national numbering register. Bear with me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Elisha. I have accessed the Openreach and S-Net porting portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is the number still recoverable, or has it been reassigned?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was the exact landline telephone number including the area code?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me while I check the quarantine status of 0115 941 8832.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for holding, Elisha. Good news: because the copper cease happened less than twenty-four hours ago, the number is currently sitting in the standard thirty-day 'quarantine reserve' pool and has not been recycled.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, thank heaven! Can you bring it back onto our fibre line?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. We can trigger an emergency number re-allocation request to map 0115 941 8832 directly to the Digital Voice SIP credentials on your Hub 5 router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does that mapping take to go live?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Emergency quarantine pulls typically provision across the central telephony softswitch within fifteen to thirty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Do I need to plug the telephone handset into the back of the green port on the Hub 5?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. The green RJ11 telephone port on the back of the Hub 5 connects to your existing cordless base station.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check that now. Yes, the grey phone cable is plugged firmly into that green phone port.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm the hardware, is the Phone LED light on the front of your Hub 5 unlit or illuminated right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is currently completely unlit, dark.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's because the VoIP SIP profile was absent. I am submitting the emergency re-allocation order right now through our wholesale gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am watching the router front panel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Order reference ENR-48902 has been accepted by the numbering registrar.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now I am pushing the SIP credentials down to your Hub 5 via remote TR-069 management. Bear with me for sixty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Elisha. Look at the Hub 5 front panel now. Has the Phone LED changed?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! The Phone LED just lit up solid green!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before we run an inbound test, the number we re-allocated is 0115 941 8832, correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Pick up your cordless phone handset and check if you hear a dial tone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding the phone to my ear... Yes, clear standard dial tone!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, what is your mobile phone number so I can dial your landline from our test desk?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile is 07700 900821.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am dialing 0115 941 8832 from our outbound test trunk right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's ringing! The landline phone in my hallway is ringing!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead and answer it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Marcus, can you hear me through the landline?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, I can hear you loud and clear over high-definition Digital Voice, Elisha.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, this is such an enormous relief. The call quality is actually much clearer than the old crackly copper wire!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's test making an outgoing call from the landline handset to your mobile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing my mobile now... My mobile is ringing and the caller display shows 0115 941 8832!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms both inbound and outbound routing are fully restored and authenticated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have no idea what a nightmare this has averted for my family, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously losing a family number of twenty-five years is something we always strive to prevent during switchovers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am just so grateful you were able to pluck it out of quarantine before someone else got it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's permanently locked to your account contract now, so it will remain safe.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And does my monthly tariff stay the same?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Digital Voice line rental and your UK weekend call plan remain at the exact same monthly cost.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's wonderful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your new fibre service that I can help you with today, Elisha?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, the broadband is lightning fast and our precious landline is back. Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net, Elisha, and enjoy your evening.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus, goodbye.
